@common.attachEmailPlaceholder.sameAsSourceJustification: Example email address "you@example.com": a recognizable placeholder format, kept literal so the @-pattern still reads as an email hint. Apple/Microsoft zh keep example addresses in this Latin form.

@common.sizeUnit.kibibyte.sameAsSourceJustification: IEC binary symbol, kept Latin: Chinese writes IEC and SI unit symbols in Latin letters (macOS zh-CN Finder: 64.0 MB/1.33 GB; Double Commander zh leaves KB/MB untranslated), so the binary set stays Latin and distinct from the decimal one.
